title_en: In the Courtroom (20/20): Mediating a Noise Dispute Between Neighbors
note_en: A 到 after a verb marks that the action actually reaches its target or result: 影响到了全家人的睡眠 "(the noise) got to the whole family's sleep," and 调解员了解到 "the mediator found out." English usually builds this into the verb itself (find out, reach, affect), but in Chinese 影响 or 了解 alone just names the activity, while adding 到 signals that it landed on something.
